title: Scorer: attribute metrics, pairwise grouping, mention negatives
description:
Teach the scorer the new metrics so the labels produce numbers.

## Scope

- Mentions: negatives inside exhaustive scopes count against precision (existing rule), now that real negatives exist.
- Attribute metrics on the vendor pattern: for owner, touches, syntax kind, and scope extent, accuracy over matched gold that asserts the attribute, with its own denominator and computability state.
- Grouping layer: pairwise precision and recall over pairs of positive mentions (same group in gold vs. same declaration group in scanner output).
- Scanner findings that lack an attribute count as wrong for that attribute, not as unscorable, once the scanner declares the capability.
- Scorecard vector and `canonical-representation.md` updated. No cross-layer scalar.

## Done when

The scorecard on the example packet shows each new metric with a correct hand-checked value.
